text: 中国人民银行行长潘功胜在出席国际货币基金组织/世界银行年会期间应约会见了欧盟委员会经济与生产力委员东布罗夫斯基斯、欧洲中央银行行长拉加德和欧元集团主席皮埃拉卡基斯，就中欧宏观经济金融政策、中欧货币金融合作等议题进行了交流。
text_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng, while attending the IMF/World Bank Annual Meetings, met on request with European Commission Commissioner for Economy and Productivity Dombrovskis, European Central Bank President Lagarde, and Eurogroup President Pierrakakis, exchanging views on China-EU macroeconomic and financial policies, China-EU monetary and financial cooperation, and other topics.
